lines: Every number comes from real HandOver runs: each step's camera check, each Next press, each mistake the camera caught. Expert time is the expert's own take.
Green = verified by the camera. Amber = mistake caught. Times in Madison time (CST).

frame.title: Time per step: learners vs the expert
frame.description: Median seconds a learner spent on each step, next to the expert's own time in the take.

frame.title: How each step was passed
frame.description: Camera = the check saw the step done. Button or Voice = the learner pressed Next.

frame.title: Mistakes the camera caught
frame.description: Behind = still looks like the previous step. Ahead = already on the next step.

lines: How often the check said yes, no or unsure, how long it took, and where it let people through too early.

frame.title: Manual-advance rate (camera steps)
frame.description: Share of advances on camera steps forced with Next instead of a camera pass.

frame.title: False passes
frame.description: Camera passes the learner undid with Back within 60 s. A lower bound.

frame.title: Checks off incidents
frame.description: The breaker opened; learners used Next until it closed.
